summary: Sexual harassment inquiry; procedural fairness under Articles 14, 311; adherence to 'as far as practicable' standard in POSH Act compliance; improper denial of legal representation; biased committee composition; ex parte inquiry; penalty of dismissal quashed; POSH inquiry principles vs departmental proceedings; natural justice violations in whirlwind proceedings.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment dismissing writ petition set aside; dismissal penalty quashed; inquiry declared void ab initio due to procedural irregularities.
